votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of September 9, 2025, September 16, 2025, October 7, 2025, and October 14, 2025, as well as the formal meeting minutes of August 19, 2025, October 7, 2025, October 21, 2025, and December 9, 2025.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes. A routine administrative action to formally adopt the record of past meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 3 of 2026 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing March as National Women's History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution between the City Council and Mayor recognizing March as National Women's History Month and acknowledging the League of Women Voters of Utah for its advocacy work.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B-1 through B-5 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on five grant applications (EPA Brownfields, Paul Coverdell Forensic Science, SJI Strategic Planning, Sister Cities International, and Bureau of EMS Per Capita grants) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Rio Grande Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezoning of 32 properties in the Rio Grande District from G-MU to D-4 and amendment of the Downtown Plan, deferring a final vote to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Fence and Hedge Height Text Amendment to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code regarding fence and hedge heights in manufacturing and residential districts, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 527, 537, and 539 South 400 East to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezoning from RMF-45 to MU-5 and master plan amendment for properties at 527, 537, and 539 South 400 East, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Recurring Nuisance Properties Ordinance to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed ordinance amending Title 11 of the Salt Lake City Code to address persistent nuisance activity on private properties and at commercial businesses, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Temporary Street Closure for Temple Square 2027 Reopening ordinance to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed ordinance that would temporarily close City streets adjacent to the Salt Lake City Temple between March and October 2027 for the Temple Reopening Celebration, deferring final action to a later meeting.

Approves a consent agenda including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and property matters, and approving board appointments and reappointments to the Airport Board and Arts Council.
